requirements: R1: Implement saved searches and favorites for document retrieval
R2: Provide real-time auto-suggestions and typo correction in the search bar
R3: Apply document type, specialty, education level, and update date filters to search results

slices.title: Patch search components with advanced filters, auto-suggestions, and favorites
slices.jtbd: When implementing the search enhancements for this epic, I want to integrate filters, suggestions, and favorites into the existing search interface, so that users experience a seamless document retrieval process.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the existing search interface,
When a user applies filters, types a query, or favorites a document,
Then the system correctly filters results, provides suggestions, and saves preferences.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease average search refinement time by 30%

slices.title: Verify search enhancements across the test pyramid
slices.jtbd: When verifying the search enhancements for this epic, I want to ensure auto-suggestions, filters, and favorites work flawlessly, so that the search experience is robust and error-free.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the patched search implementation,
When E2E tests are executed for filters and favorites,
Then the test suite confirms all new search capabilities function without regressions.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Maintain 100% test pass rate for all new search capabilities

requirements: R1: Enable comments and update requests on knowledge base documents

slices.title: Patch document view to support comments and update requests
slices.jtbd: When implementing document feedback for this epic, I want to add comment and update request actions to the document view, so that users can communicate content issues directly.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a loaded document in the UI,
When a user submits a comment or update request,
Then the existing API is called to securely record the feedback and notify managers.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce time to submit document feedback by 50%

slices.title: Verify document feedback mechanisms
slices.jtbd: When testing the document feedback feature for this epic, I want to validate the comment submission flow, so that content managers reliably receive user feedback.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the patched document view,
When E2E tests simulate a user submitting a comment,
Then the system successfully processes and records the submission without errors.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% test coverage for the document feedback submission path

epics.title: System Authentication and Session Management
epics.jtbd: When an educational center participant accesses the platform, I want to authenticate via corporate credentials or standard login, so that my identity is securely verified and role permissions are properly enforced.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthenticated session access attempts by 99%
epics.tocConstraintRef: System security and identity verification boundary
requirements: R1: Support authentication via corporate account or login/password
R2: Issue and validate secure session tokens for user requests

slices.title: Patch existing security configuration to enforce robust authentication
slices.jtbd: When implementing authentication for this epic, I want to configure the security context to process corporate credentials and issue secure tokens, so that unverified access is blocked.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated request to the platform,
When the user provides valid corporate credentials,
Then a secure session token is issued and the user is authenticated.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Ensure 0% rate of unauthorized access due to missing token verification

slices.title: Verify authentication and session token issuance
slices.jtbd: When verifying the authentication flow for this epic, I want to test login and token validation, so that the system is proven secure against unverified headers.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the updated authentication layer,
When integration tests attempt login with both valid and invalid credentials,
Then the tests verify that only valid logins receive a secure session token.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Maintain 100% pass rate for authentication security tests
